name: gstack
description: Stack-based git workflows. Includes the core git workflow from Basics.

actions.label: New stack entry
actions.description: Create a new stack entry from current branch.

args.name: name
args.description: Name for the new stack entry.

actions.label: Submit stack
actions.description: Submit the current stack as PRs.

actions.label: Restack
actions.description: Rebase all stack entries on the latest base.

actions.label: Sync stack
actions.description: Pull latest base and update all stack entries.

actions.label: Stack diff
actions.description: Show diff for the current stack entry.

actions.label: Checkout entry
actions.description: Switch to a different stack entry.

args.name: entry
args.description: Stack entry name to switch to.

actions.label: Commit
actions.description: Commit current changes with an AI-written message.
actions.template: Commit the current changes with a clear message. Don't commit any files that contain secrets.

actions.label: Resolve conflicts
actions.description: Resolve merge conflicts, asking before guessing.
actions.template: Resolve the current merge conflicts. Ask before guessing on anything ambiguous.

actions.label: Push branch
actions.description: Push this branch to the remote.

actions.label: Create PR
actions.description: Open a PR for this branch against main.
actions.template: Create a PR for this branch against {main}.

actions.label: Review
actions.description: Run the agent's built-in code review on this branch.
